races.paceDynamic: Lady Dora Mae will take this field along from the front with Handle With Care and Cool Molly tracking close behind, creating a solid early gallop over this straight seven furlongs. The majority of the field are hold-up horses who will be relying on the pace to set up their finishing kicks. With standard ground conditions and a sustained tempo likely, the race will develop into a cavalry charge from the three-furlong pole as the back markers try to reel in the leaders. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the pace will be genuine enough to string out the field and create opportunities for those with finishing speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong enough to set up the closers
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will stretch the field and allow the patient riders to time their challenges perfectly from off the pace. Horses like Madame De Sevigne and So Sassy will benefit from the strong tempo and can unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Hold On
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is more moderate than expected allowing the leaders to kick clear
scenarios.body: Handle With Care and Cool Molly can dictate terms from prominent positions and have enough left in the tank to repel late challenges. Their class and tactical speed will prove decisive in a more tactical affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Dora Mae goes too slow early and kills the race
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace will turn this into a sprint finish where horses with natural speed rather than stamina will prosper. Cool Molly's recent winning form over shorter trips could be the key advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Dora Mae gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: George Boughey's filly can utilise her recent winning form to dictate throughout and maintain her advantage to the line. Her two recent victories suggest she's found her form at the right time.

races.paceDynamic: St Faz will look to dictate from the front with his sustained galloping style, likely joined by Shrimp Shady and Circuit Breaker in the early stages to create a genuine pace over this marathon trip. The bulk of the field consists of hold-up horses including Appier, Charlie's Choice, Dance Time and Francesco Baracca who will settle towards the rear and look to pick off the leaders. With only one natural front-runner and multiple patient types, the pace will be honest but not frantic, allowing the field to stay in touch before a prolonged drive from the two-furlong pole. This setup moderately favours hold-up horses — the genuine gallop will stretch the field and create opportunities for patient riders with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace proves testing enough to stretch the prominent racers without being suicidal
scenarios.body: The marathon distance and honest gallop will find out the weaker stayers among the early leaders, while the class hold-up horses time their challenges perfectly. Appier's excellent recent form and Charlie's Choice's proven stamina reserves make them prime beneficiaries of this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runners Steal March
scenarios.trigger: If St Faz gets an easy lead and the hold-up horses fail to close strongly enough
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows St Faz to control the tempo perfectly, while Shrimp Shady benefits from Balding's excellent form and settles just behind before striking. The patient horses leave their runs too late over this extreme distance.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a truly-run affair that sets up perfectly for maximum stamina
scenarios.body: The combination of honest early pace and extreme distance creates the perfect storm for a horse with serious staying power to emerge from the pack. Selenic's Prescott training and Arc Zoosve's light weight become decisive factors in a stamina test.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Shock
scenarios.trigger: If St Faz goes too slow early and it becomes a sprint finish over the final three furlongs
scenarios.body: The marathon distance becomes academic as tactical speed rather than pure stamina decides the outcome. Horses with recent shorter-distance form and tactical pace find themselves perfectly positioned for a shock result.

races.paceDynamic: Robusto is the sole confirmed front-runner and will likely get an uncontested lead with Bystander and The Bay Warrior sitting behind him in the early stages. With 14 of the 16 runners adopting hold-up tactics, there's minimal early pace pressure which should allow Robusto to dictate terms through steady sectionals. The massive bias toward hold-up runners means the field will be bunched and traffic-dependent in the closing stages, creating a cavalry charge finish. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses with tactical speed — the lack of pace pressure means they'll get the run of the race and can time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Robusto sets uncontested fractions and the field remains bunched.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows hold-up specialists to position perfectly and unleash late kicks. Traffic problems will eliminate some contenders but the best travellers with room will prevail.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Running Pays Off
scenarios.trigger: If Robusto maintains his lead and the hold-up brigade leave it too late.
scenarios.body: With so many hold-up horses waiting, none coordinate their challenges effectively and Robusto stays clear. The lack of early pressure preserves his stamina for a strong finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Bystander and The Bay Warrior track Robusto closely and kick before the hold-up horses.
scenarios.body: The prominent pair get first run on the field while the hold-up brigade are still organising their challenges. Their positioning advantage proves decisive in a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Robusto goes too slowly early and creates a sprint finish from the 3f pole.
scenarios.body: The bunched field becomes a lottery with interference and traffic problems deciding the outcome. Long-shots who get clear runs can capitalise on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Robusto must be monitored closely early - if he sets genuine fractions rather than dawdling, it completely changes the race dynamic
Wonder and Damascus Steel for traffic problems in the closing stages - their hold-up style makes them vulnerable in a bunched finish
Latin for improvement wearing headgear for the second time after responding positively to the new equipment last week
Multiple 7lb claimers aboard hold-up horses could cause steering issues in a cavalry charge finish - watch Myla Coppins and Toby Moore particularly
Track Bystander's early positioning as the main danger to Robusto's uncontested lead - his prominent style could force a stronger pace
